transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you to the clinic?

I'm here because I can't stop having these awful, vivid memories of a traumatic event that happened about a year and a half ago. I also keep having really distressing nightmares about it, and I just don't know what to do anymore.
Since the traumatic event, do you try to avoid reminders of it, such as places, people, conversations, or thoughts about what happened?

Yes, I do everything I can to avoid thinking or talking about it because the memories are just too painful. I also completely stay away from certain places and people that remind me of what happened, just to keep from falling apart.
Since the trauma, have you been feeling more on edge than before, such as being easily startled, constantly alert, irritable, or having trouble sleeping?

My sleep has been completely ruined since then. I have a really hard time falling asleep, and when I finally do, I wake up constantly throughout the night or wake up way too early. I just feel exhausted all the time because of it.
Have these symptoms been going on for more than one month?

Yes, they have been going on for much longer than just a month. I've been struggling with all of this for about a year and a half now, ever since the event happened. It has been a constant battle every single day.
